subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers continue with the open conflicting fork PR as the fix path, or close/replace it with a fresh current-main Debug Snapshots fix?
rationale: The bug is still present, but a linked closing PR already exists and is conflicting, so automation should not open a duplicate fix until a maintainer chooses the path.

options.title: Replace With Fresh Current-Main Fix
options.body: Close or supersede the stale fork path and queue a narrow current-main fix with localization, tests, and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt And Rebase The Fork PR
options.body: Keep the fork PR as the contributor path, but require a rebase, current Debug page changes, localization, tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Defer The UX Repair
options.body: Leave the issue open without a repair path if maintainers want to defer Debug tab polish behind broader diagnostics work.

recommendation.title: Replace With Fresh Current-Main Fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale fork path and queue a narrow current-main fix with localization, tests, and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently refactored the current Debug page ownership boundary and can best judge whether to repair the route-owned surface directly.
